items.subject: A 30-minute chat about your reports
items.body:
Hi Dev,

You wrote to us about getting numbers out of Fernway, and I'd like to hear how that goes for you each week. It's a 30-minute call about how you use the reports and what happens to them after.

If you're up for it, pick any time that suits you:
https://book.example/your-name

No worries at all if not.
items.rationale: Why they fit, the study's line and your booking link.
